title: Fix VS Code Copilot Chat Native Hooks
description: VS Code hooks are not calling semio-repo hooks. Need to fix the hook output format to produce VS Code-compatible JSON, extract tool_name from stdin, and use proper hookSpecificOutput with permissionDecision for PreToolUse events.
summary: Fixed 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading hookSpecificOutput)' in VS Code Copilot Chat v0.37.6. Root cause: formatVSCodeHookOutput returned {} for UserPromptSubmit/PostToolUse/Stop/SubagentStop/PreCompact events. VS Code _toHookResult strips continue/stopReason/systemMessage leaving empty object → output=undefined. The UserPromptSubmit onSuccess callback accesses d.hookSpecificOutput without null-checking d. Fix: always include hookSpecificOutput for all VS Code hook events. Updated tests. All hook tests pass.
